scope: Eight evaluated checkpoints and 16 adopted datasets; API placeholders are not evaluated.
policy: Training involvement includes direct or upstream use at any training/development stage. Count documented seed fine-tuning, pseudo-label teachers, retained-backbone pretraining and final-model fine-tuning; explicit development calibration is counted and labelled separately. Source statements and supported lineage inferences suffice; no need for the final checkpoint to reread original audio. Evidence levels describe mechanism/strength, not whether upstream use is excluded.
unhatched_meaning: No established corpus-specific training involvement; not verified unseen. Corpus-level involvement is not test-file leakage.

e2v_owner_large_data.speaker: repository owner ddlBoJack

emobox_inventory.fact: 32 datasets/294.4 hours inventory; the seed card says 201 hours, without exact selected-corpus or split list.

original_e2v_paper.fact: Original emotion2vec self-supervised pretraining includes IEMOCAP, MELD, MEAD, CMU-MOSEI, MSP-Podcast v1.8. Its initial data2vec/data2vec2 base checkpoints are LibriSpeech models. Does not establish these raw corpora were used by the selected plus-large checkpoint.

mera_paper.fact: SER training names CREMA-D, ESD, MELD, M3ED plus proprietary SG-ECMT/SGTV. SG-ECMT labels use seed/base agreement then MERaLiON relabeling.

mera_backbone.fact: Export reconstructs a Whisper-medium encoder from official openai/whisper-medium snapshot abdf7c39ab9d0397620ccaea8974cc764cd0953e, then merges LoRA.

whisper_pretraining.fact: 680,000 hours of internet audio/transcripts. Exact source-record list not public; no adopted-corpus exclusion follows from not being named.

confirmed_exposure.label: Used directly
confirmed_exposure.definition: A credible paper, report, model card or author statement explicitly names this corpus for the selected checkpoint or a retained component. This is source-supported, not an absolute guarantee.

probable_exposure.label: Used via upstream training
probable_exposure.definition: Credible sources support a specific upstream corpus-family/teacher/data-iteration chain. Individual corpus subset, retained weights and final raw-audio use can remain unverified; this category records an indirect-influence inference, not confirmation of direct training.

possible_exposure.label: Possible association
possible_exposure.definition: A relevant teacher/family/development association exists, but corpus selection, checkpoint inheritance or applicability is unresolved. Does not assert direct raw-audio training.

not_established.label: No corpus-specific evidence
not_established.definition: No corpus-specific training association found. General model training information can still be known. Does not mean verified unseen.

project_used_definition: Count a corpus as used if credible sources support its involvement anywhere upstream in the training pipeline, including seed fine-tuning or teachers that supply pseudo-labels. Both confirmed_exposure and probable_exposure are used (in_training_data=true). Distinguish the mechanism without requiring final-model rereading of the original audio. Explicit author development calibration is counted as seen too, with its stage and applicability disclosed.
display_policy: A single /// hatch (or dagger) means part of the training process. Direct and upstream uses share the same marker. Detailed source judgments are audit metadata, not separate figure categories.
